en.headline: Paediatric expert says hard to predict flu peak, urges vaccination
en.dek: Dr Kwan Yat-wah said Hong Kong faces a triple epidemic of influenza, COVID-19 and RSV, and the recent child death from H3 influenza was an individual case that should not undermine vaccine confidence.
body: Asia Pacific Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases president and University of Hong Kong honorary clinical associate professor Dr Kwan Yat-wah said on Saturday it was difficult to estimate when the current influenza season would peak or whether it would extend into the new school year.

Speaking after the first child influenza death of the year — a seven-year-old boy who had received the seasonal flu vaccine and later developed shock and encephalopathy — Kwan said he would not comment on the individual case. He noted that some patients experience a strong immune reaction known as a cytokine storm that can cause widespread inflammation, including in the brain, which antibodies may not fully control.

Kwan said Hong Kong is currently under a ‘triple epidemic’ of influenza, COVID-19 and respiratory syncytial virus, with influenza predominant. RSV can cause bronchiolitis and pneumonia in children, while COVID-19 has been linked to cases of croup. Although there is no COVID-19 vaccination programme specifically for children, adults can still reduce risk by vaccination and thereby protect young family members.
He reiterated that vaccination remains important to prevent severe disease and death, and that overall population antibody levels decline months after the last campaign.

zh.headline: 關日華：難估計流感何時見頂 籲接種疫苗
zh.dek: 亞洲兒童傳染病學會會長指本港現受「三疫夾擊」，近期兒童甲流死亡屬個別事件，不應動搖對疫苗信心。
body: 亞洲兒童傳染病學會會長、港大兒童及青少年科名譽臨床副教授關日華周六表示，目前難以估計流感何時會見頂，以及會否延續至新學年開學後。
在本港出現今年首宗兒童流感死亡個案後，關日華說不會評論該宗個案，但指出個別人士感染後可能出現「細胞因子風暴」，引致腦部等多處發炎，即使已接種疫苗，抗體亦未必能完全控制病情。
他指本港現時受到流感、新冠及呼吸道合胞病毒「三疫夾擊」，以流感為主。合胞病毒可引致兒童氣管炎及肺炎，新冠亦見部分兒童出現獅哮症。雖然現時沒有針對兒童的新冠疫苗接種計劃，但成年人仍可透過接種減低感染風險，保護家中幼童。
關日華重申市民應接種流感疫苗，以預防重症及死亡，並指出距離上一次疫苗接種計劃已過半年，整體人口抗體水平逐漸下降。
